[1/2] Levels cycle: surge pickup beacon + distance label, presentation-only, visual pair and pickup run

impact_assessment.why: The wave-2 surge pickup is fully occluded by the centre cover from spawn; players get no visible cue to the reward.
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes the level affordance discoverable without moving the pickup or changing its trigger/economy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (snapshot unchanged); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: two presentation nodes must hide after the pickup and on rebuild.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests pin visibility/position/hide and the 18m label gate; baseline-vs-after pickup run must match hash, events and final state.

Task 'shooter-cycle-03-pickup-beacon' completed successfully.
[1/2] UI readability cycle: single HP/ammo source + crosshair contrast, presentation-only, visual pair and identical play hashes

impact_assessment.why: Every frame printed HP/ammo twice and the white crosshair disappeared on the white muzzle flash.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cleaner HUD with one source of truth and a crosshair readable on any background.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no snapshot change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none (draw-only).
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin no-duplicate and five-backing/five-core tests; re-run kite/strafe and compare hashes.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] UI readability proven: 58 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 15856px HUD pair, identical kite/strafe hashes; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-04-ui-readability' completed successfully.
[1/2] Graphics cycle: floor grid, lifted lighting, shared lit trim, visual pairs and identical play hashes

impact_assessment.why: The arena floor and cover tops dissolved into a near-black background; the level lacked landmarks.
impact_assessment.benefits: Readable floor, depth from the grid, and lit cover/wall edges at one instanced batch.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (render only); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: ten trim nodes and one texture must stay out of sim.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin texture determinism, shared material/mesh identity, collider parity and the draw/triangle budget; re-run all play hashes.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Arena graphics proven: 63 tests, determinism 1800 ok, luma +4.3 spawn, 9 draws/1774 tris boss, identical play hashes; checklists: passed
[1/2] Audio cycle: boss/engagement voices, captions, clip hook, WAV/spectrogram evidence and same-hash played runs

impact_assessment.why: Boss windup/slam and engagement events were silent; only the visual telegraph warned the player.
impact_assessment.benefits: Audible boss/engagement cues plus visible captions improve reaction time and accessibility.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot unchanged (boss_down is an event only); dependency: probe uses numpy/Pillow already pinned; concurrency: none; state: caption timer is presentation-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin event-to-voice/caption tests, same-hash played-run parity, voice cap/drop counts and a 0 px spawn regression.

[1/2] Progression cycle: versioned atomic profile, BEST HUD, run debrief, schema/quarantine tests, death pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: No state outlived a launch; bests and last run were lost and death showed only YOU DIED.
impact_assessment.benefits: Persistent personal bests, run count and a post-run debrief without touching gameplay balance.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ShooterGame gains profile_path and persisted state; dependency: keystone.serialization only; concurrency: two processes could save; state: unsupported schema must not be overwritten.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Atomic replace + .bak + lock, schema refusal disables saving, corrupt quarantine, temp profiles in every evidence script and test.
